classification_rationale: A wrong result is presented as correct with a clean status.

classification_rationale: No test discriminates the root-bit gate.

trigger: EACCES on /.dockerenv with a plain readable cgroup (mutant M16 survived).
summary: A marker-probe failure with a readable cgroup was never asserted on the container verdict. The wrong outcome cannot occur today, so the facts derive LOW; the reporter labelled it SHOULD.
classification_rationale: No test pins the verdict for a failed marker probe.

trigger: A regression that ignores SMBIOS unreadable in the step-2 confidence (mutant M3 survived).
summary: Step-2 medium confidence on unreadable SMBIOS was untested.
classification_rationale: Missing test.

summary: Two cgroup edge forms were unpinned.
classification_rationale: Missing negative tests.

classification_rationale: Documented grammar had no enforcing test.

summary: The comment says backslashes are escaped; safe_output_field folds backslash to slash and newline to space and escapes only the pipe. The header's 'single dispatch #if' is two chains.

classification_rationale: The probe cannot cover the x86 branch.

summary: Convention note: raw error codes stay inside the pure-core seam; errno_token is the one mapper. Not worth std::expected.
classification_rationale: Convention observation.

summary: bare_metal means 'no virtualization signal seen' but the definition and README read as proof of physical hardware (same class as accepted caveat 4).
classification_rationale: Wording overstates certainty.

trigger: A consumer reads only the definition (REST or MCP discovery) and queries a KVM host, a Xen dom0 or an ARM host.
summary: Known limits live only in the README and matrix, not in the definition's metadata description. Also raised by the architect (N1).
classification_rationale: Limits missing from the discovery text.

summary: The description omits that data can be up to an hour old, that constrained is terminal until permissions change and that unsupported means the leg threw.
classification_rationale: Freshness and terminal-versus-retryable meanings missing.

trigger: A future change leaks a Type 1 serial or UUID into a row.
summary: No test fed a Type 1 table with serial and UUID and asserted the rows omit them; non-emission was structural only. Optional.
classification_rationale: The stated control had no evidence.

trigger: A hung procfs or sysfs read (wedged cgroup_mutex, a FUSE or bind mount over /sys/class/dmi/id) during /proc/self/cgroup, DMI or access() reads.
summary: posix_secure_read has no wall-clock bound (O_NONBLOCK only defuses FIFOs), so a hung read pins an agent pool worker; per-device claims release on TIMEOUT so retries pin the rest. Sibling plugins share the gap and disclose it as #4875; this plugin's README and privilege row did not.
classification_rationale: The sibling-standard no-deadline disclosure was missing.

trigger: CPUID faulting (ARCH_SET_CPUID=0) set on the agent process by a ptrace-style sandbox or enclave runtime.
summary: Raw CPUID runs in process on Linux x86; a faulting CPUID would SIGSEGV the agent on each dispatch and ABI containment is try/catch only. No production trigger was found; the reporter and chaos-injector recommended rejection.
classification_rationale: No containment for a hardware-fault path; no trigger exists.

trigger: A VM owner sets DMI strings with terminal control bytes (ESC, VT, FF, U+2028, U+0085).
summary: Other control bytes pass through the shared safe_output_field into the host row; output is bounded at 4 KiB per field and consumer rendering was not verified. Sibling convention.
classification_rationale: The shared helper does not neutralise these bytes.

trigger: An ARM VM with no sysfs, or any ARM64 host with neither CPUID nor an OS hint.
summary: Reads unknown plus constrained permanently, so ARM fleets always show constrained status noise. By design and in the descriptor limit.
classification_rationale: Documented conservative behaviour.

trigger: bad_alloc after the first write_output row.
summary: A late throw leaves status|supported, a host row and no container row, then the catch arm appends status|unsupported (two status rows; the typed result is last-wins UNAVAILABLE). Documented and tested; mitigated by the typed status.
classification_rationale: Documented contract.

trigger: A new server dispatches to an agent that reports an empty plugin inventory.
summary: An empty inventory is treated as unknown and gets the dispatch; the agent answers REJECTED plugin not found. A visible terminal result, no retry loop.
classification_rationale: Handled fail-open edge.

trigger: Agent stop or restart while a read is pinned (risk-register entry).
summary: Agent stop or restart while a read is pinned. Handled: stateless plugin, no-op shutdown, ShutdownDeadlineGuard hard-exits after 20 s. Register entry recorded for completeness; the reporter found no defect.
classification_rationale: Verified-handled register entry, not a defect.

trigger: Huge or hostile /proc/self/cgroup (risk-register entry).
summary: Huge or hostile /proc/self/cgroup. Handled: 64 KiB cap gives cgroup_oversized, container unknown, status constrained; parse is linear. Register entry recorded for completeness; the reporter found no defect.
classification_rationale: Verified-handled register entry, not a defect.

trigger: CPUID zeroed, masked or inconsistent between calls (risk-register entry).
summary: CPUID zeroed, masked or inconsistent between calls. Handled: unknown signature gives other at medium; covered by the 5M-case property test. Register entry recorded for completeness; the reporter found no defect.
classification_rationale: Verified-handled register entry, not a defect.

trigger: Non-root or hardened service account (risk-register entry).
summary: Non-root or hardened service account. Handled: EACCES and EPERM give permission_denied tokens and never bare_metal. Register entry recorded for completeness; the reporter found no defect.
classification_rationale: Verified-handled register entry, not a defect.

trigger: Windows RSMB garbage, size race, call failure (risk-register entry).
summary: Windows RSMB garbage, size race, call failure. Handled: three attempts then size_race, 1 MiB cap, 0 gives call_failed; a framing fault is unreadable. Register entry recorded for completeness; the reporter found no defect.
classification_rationale: Verified-handled register entry, not a defect.

trigger: Two concurrent executions, unload mid-call (risk-register entry).
summary: Two concurrent executions, unload mid-call. Handled: no shared mutable state; plugins are loaded once and dlclosed only at teardown. Register entry recorded for completeness; the reporter found no defect.
classification_rationale: Verified-handled register entry, not a defect.

trigger: Kill switch toggled mid-run (risk-register entry).
summary: Kill switch toggled mid-run. Handled: enforcement is at dispatch and overlay only; an in-flight read-only run finishes. Register entry recorded for completeness; the reporter found no defect.
classification_rationale: Verified-handled register entry, not a defect.

No reachable trigger. arch_prctl(2) ARCH_SET_CPUID is preserved across fork and clone but reset to the default (cpuid enabled) on execve, so no launcher, unit or sandbox can hand the agent a faulting CPUID; the live process could only be changed by a ptracer already holding full control. The plugin also adds no CPUID to the process: glibc's loader executes CPUID before main and linux.cpp's __get_cpuid_max executes leaf 0 before anything else.
